items.title: AI健康彻底火了！蚂蚁阿福之后，ChatGPT今日跟进发布健康服务
items.raw_excerpt: 1月8日，OpenAI推出 ChatGPT Health功能，可解答健康问题、链接智能设备、规划饮食运动，功能和“蚂蚁阿福”相似。 蚂蚁集团旗下“蚂蚁阿福”火爆之后，OpenAI也决定入局AI医疗健康领域。据悉，蚂蚁阿福新版发布一个月后，最新月活跃用户数已达3000万，用户单日提问量已超1000万，一个月时间翻倍。 蚂蚁阿福的快速发展，足见健康正在成为需求爆发的领域。OpenAI发布ChatGPT Health功能时也表示，健康已经成为用户最常使用AI的领域，全球每周有超过2.3亿⼈在ChatGPT 上咨询健康和健身相关的问题。 作为第一个AI健康专业应用，蚂蚁阿福的12月新版本提供健康问答、健康陪伴、健康服务三大功能，打通了从日常健康咨询到在线问诊、线下就医的全链路服务，链接了全国5000家医院、30万真人医生在线问诊，支持打通苹果、华为、OPPO、vivo、鱼跃等十大品牌智能设备。新发布的ChatGPT Health功能和阿福相似，有健康问答、报告解读、链接智能设备等功能，但还未打通挂号、在线问诊等就医资源和环节。 OpenAI方面表示，ChatGPT Health目前还只向⼀⼩部分早期⽤户开放。 国内，上线半年的蚂蚁阿福正处于快速发展期。最新数据显示，相较于一个月前，蚂蚁阿福的单日用户提问数和月活用户数双双翻倍，单日用户提问数已超1000万，月活跃用户数则达3000万。

excerpt_i18n.en: On January 8, OpenAI launched ChatGPT Health, a feature capable of answering health questions, connecting to smart devices, and planning diet and exercise, with functions similar to "Ant Fortune." Following the popularity of Ant Group's "Ant Fortune," OpenAI has also decided to enter the AI healthcare field. It is reported that one month after the new version of Ant Fortune was released, its latest monthly active users reached 30 million, with daily user inquiries exceeding 10 million, doubling within a month. The rapid development of Ant Fortune highlights that health is becoming an area of explosive demand. When OpenAI released ChatGPT Health, it also stated that health has become the most common area for users to utilize AI, with over 230 million people worldwide consulting ChatGPT on health and fitness-related questions weekly. As the first professional AI health application, the December new version of Ant Fortune offers three major functions: health Q&A, health companionship, and health services, integrating full-chain services from daily health consultations to online consultations and offline medical visits. It connects to 5,000 hospitals nationwide and 300,000 real doctors for online consultations, and supports integration with smart devices from ten major brands including Apple, Huawei, OPPO, vivo, and Yuwell. The newly released ChatGPT Health feature is similar to Ant Fortune, offering health Q&A, report interpretation, and smart device connectivity, but it has not yet integrated medical resources and steps such as appointment booking and online consultations. OpenAI stated that ChatGPT Health is currently only available to a small portion of users.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 8 de enero, OpenAI lanzó la función ChatGPT Health, capaz de responder preguntas de salud, conectar dispositivos inteligentes y planificar dietas y ejercicios, con funcionalidades similares a las de "Ant A Fu". Tras el éxito de "Ant A Fu" del grupo Ant, OpenAI también ha decidido entrar en el campo de la inteligencia artificial en salud y bienestar. Según se informa, un mes después del lanzamiento de la nueva versión de Ant A Fu, sus usuarios activos mensuales más recientes alcanzaron los 30 millones, y las preguntas diarias de los usuarios superaron los 10 millones, duplicándose en un mes. El rápido desarrollo de Ant A Fu demuestra claramente que la salud se está convirtiendo en un área de demanda explosiva. items.title: 「一脑多形」圆桌：世界模型、空间智能在具身智能出现了哪些具体进展？｜GAIR 2025
items.raw_excerpt: 在 12 月 13 日举行的第八届GAIR全球人工智能与机器人大会“数据&一脑多形”分论坛上，一场有关“一脑多形”的圆桌论坛，将整个会场气氛推向高潮，在英诺天使基金 ED 王建明的主持下，浙江大学控制学院副教授，微分智飞创始人高飞，宁波东方理工大学助理教授金鑫，上海人工智能实验室青年科学家王靖博三位嘉宾围绕着具身智能、空间智能、世界模型等话题进行了热烈讨论。 通过主持人特有的投资人式、抽丝剥茧的提问，围绕着几位学者的研究和创业方向，我们可以了解到当下最火热的世界模型、空间智能在具身智能领域的研究进展和细节，从而得以穿透资本笼罩在世界模型、空间智能的迷雾，看到具身智能当下遇到的挑战与机遇。 具身智能技术路线仍未收敛 王建明：三位学者研究的方向都非常不一样，开场先问一个共性的问题热热场，大家怎么看过去两年具身智能的发展？ 高飞：现在还没到技术路线收敛的时候，还属于探索阶段，这是好事，有发散才有机会。这波具身智能的热潮，大家本质期待的还是 AI 结合本体能带来的智能性的飞跃。我认为从发散探索到技术路线收敛、到最后落地阶段，大家还是要记住自己做具身智能的初心是什么。如果不是为了通用泛化智能，最后这个领域又收敛回工业自动化了，可能就没有太大的意义了。 金鑫：我也非常同意高老师的看法，我感觉这两年留给高校的机会相对产业界来讲比较少，希望未来更多把具身智能的核心问题交给高校去突破，比如交互、人机协同、多智能体、世界模型等等抽象出的关键问题，产业去做更落地的事情。希望未来两年能看到高校跟企业更好地合作、平衡。 王靖博：相比较在纯数字世界中做一些例如scaling up 的事情，我更关注具身智能软硬件的 code design，比如人形机器人十年前的波士顿动力 Atlas 就展示出了很好的运动能力，但它并没有从实验室的产品进入产业界，当有了较好的软硬件的 code design，可能

excerpt_i18n.en:
At the "Data & One-Brain-Multiple-Forms" sub-forum of the 8th GAIR Global Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Summit on December 13, a roundtable discussion on "One-Brain-Multiple-Forms" brought the event to a climax. Moderated by Wang Jianming, Executive Director of Inno Angel Fund, three guests—Associate Professor Gao Fei of Zhejiang University's College of Control Science and Engineering and founder of Differential Intelligence Flight, Assistant Professor Jin Xin of Ningbo Oriental Institute of Technology, and young scientist Wang Jingbo of Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory—engaged in a lively discussion on topics such as embodied intelligence, spatial intelligence, and world models. Through the moderator's investor-style, probing questions focused on the scholars' research and entrepreneurial directions, the audience gained insights into the latest research progress and details of the currently trending world models and spatial intelligence in the field of embodied intelligence. This helped cut through the capital-driven haze surrounding world models and spatial intelligence, revealing the current challenges and opportunities in embodied intelligence.

The technological path of embodied intelligence has not yet converged.

Wang Jianming: The research directions of the three scholars are quite different. To start, let's warm up with a common question: How do you view the development of embodied intelligence over the past two years?

Gao Fei: The technological path has not yet converged; we are still in the exploration phase, which is a good thing. Divergence creates opportunities. The essence of this wave of enthusiasm for embodied intelligence is the expectation of a leap in intelligence through the integration of AI with physical entities. I believe that from divergent exploration to the convergence of technological paths and eventual implementation, we must remember our original purpose in pursuing embodied intelligence. If it is not for generalizability and versatility...
excerpt_i18n.es: En el foro "Datos y un cerebro, múltiples formas" de la octava Conferencia Global de Inteligencia Artificial y Robótica (GAIR) celebrada el 13 de diciembre, una mesa redonda sobre "un cerebro, múltiples formas" llevó la atmósfera del evento a su punto culminante. Moderada por Wang Jianming, director ejecutivo del Fondo Ángel Inno, los invitados Gao Fei, profesor asociado de la Facultad de Control de la Universidad de Zhejiang y fundador de Differential Intelligence Flight, Jin Xin, profesor asistente de la Universidad de Ciencia y Tecnología Oriental de Ningbo, y Wang Jingbo, joven científico del Laboratorio de Inteligencia Artificial de Shanghai, mantuvieron un animado debate sobre temas como la inteligencia encarnada, la inteligencia espacial y los modelos del mundo. A través de las preguntas características del moderador, inspiradas en el enfoque de inversor y meticulosamente desglosadas, se exploraron las investigaciones y emprendimientos de los académicos.

excerpt_i18n.en: On January 6, 2026, CZUR celebrated its 12th anniversary by successfully hosting a strategic new product launch event. The company officially introduced a range of products, including the AI Meeting Robot, AI Meeting Workstation, AI Laser Meeting Display (Interactive), Omni-Control Presentation Pen, 2nd Generation TouchBoard, WritePad Wireless Seat Tablet, and TouchBoard Pro Dedicated Wireless Keyboard. Together, these products form a comprehensive smart solution covering all meeting scenarios. This launch was not merely a hardware iteration but a systematic reconstruction of modern meeting models based on the new Starry AIOS 6.0 system. It aims to drive the evolution of meeting rooms from "functional implementation" to "experience and efficiency optimization" through the concept of an "AI Minimalist Meeting Hub." AI is reshaping the entire meeting landscape, bridging the gap from legacy upgrades to process intelligence. It is reported that the AI Meeting Robot and AI Meeting Workstation emphasize a minimalist deployment philosophy of "single-cable connectivity and legacy upgrades," allowing traditional display devices to be upgraded to AI meeting terminals with just an HDMI cable, significantly reducing renovation and maintenance costs for meeting rooms. As the core AI meeting host, the AI Meeting Robot integrates an AI omnidirectional microphone, dual AI meeting cameras, intelligent dual-mode EQ audio, and a comprehensive interaction system on a commercial-grade motherboard, simplifying deployment with its complete integration. The deeper transformation lies in its built-in Starry AIOS.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 6 de enero de 2026, con motivo de su duodécimo aniversario, CZUR celebró con éxito una presentación estratégica de nuevos productos, lanzando oficialmente una gama que incluye el robot de reuniones con IA, la estación de trabajo para reuniones con IA, la pantalla grande láser para reuniones con IA (interactiva), el bolígrafo de presentación con control inteligente integral, el panel táctil TouchBoard de segunda generación, la tableta inalámbrica WritePad para asientos y el teclado táctil inalámbrico especializado TouchBoard Pro. Juntos, conforman una solución inteligente que cubre todos los escenarios de reuniones. Esta presentación no es solo una iteración de hardware individual, sino una redefinición de los modelos de reuniones modernas basada en el nuevo sistema Starry AIOS 6.0.

excerpt_i18n.es: Hoy en día, aunque las herramientas de IA son cada vez más numerosas, la eficiencia de los usuarios no necesariamente mejora al mismo ritmo. ¿Cuáles son las necesidades productivas esenciales que abordan los puntos críticos y resultan indispensables una vez utilizadas? ¿Y cuáles son las aplicaciones que parecen impresionantes pero en realidad son de poca utilidad? La respuesta no está en la publicidad omnipresente, sino en las situaciones reales de los usuarios.
